name: Cloze
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: AI shopping assistant for Shopify: a chat widget wired to your live catalogue, inventory and knowledge base that answers product questions, compares items, tracks orders and hands off to a human. New listing: no reviews yet as of 19 Aug 2026.
best_for: Shopify stores with a catalogue big enough that shoppers ask which item to buy, who want a chat assistant that reads live inventory and hands off to a person, and who will watch the transcripts
skip_if: your support volume is low, or you want proof from other merchants before you put an AI in front of customers: there are no reviews yet
honest_knock: Two things to weigh, and the first is the price itself. On the same day, the App Store listing sold this at $49, $99 and $199 a month for 250, 750 and 2,000 conversations. The vendor's own site sold it at $29 and $79, with unlimited conversations on both paid tiers. The screenshot below is that page. Two prices and two different meters for one product is not a discount you can claim, it is an inconsistency to ask about before you pay. The second is the track record, or the absence of one. The app launched 24 April 2026 and, as of 4 September 2026, carries exactly one review: five stars, left after eight days of use. So there is next to no merchant experience to lean on, and the “Built for Shopify” badge is a technical bar, not a verdict on the answers. Also note what a conversation costs when it goes wrong. An assistant wired to live inventory and order tracking is answering with your data, and the free tier's 25 conversations a month is enough to test the tone but not enough to see it handle a bad day. The listing promises a 3 day trial on paid plans (read 16 Nov 2026), which is short for a support tool, and the Starter approval screen in the app showed no trial on 16 Nov 2026, so ask before you rely on it.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 250 AI conversations on the App Store listing, plus $0.10 per extra conversation
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-19, re-verified unchanged 2026-09-04 on apps.shopify.com/cloze, listed as “Cloze: AI Shopping Assistant”) Free plan available: 25 AI conversations a month, up to 100 synced products, core assistant customisation and 7 days of conversation history. Paid tiers are Starter $49, Pro $99 and Scale $199 a month, each with $0.10 per additional AI conversation and, on the listing, a 3 day free trial; in the app on 16 Nov 2026 the Starter approval screen showed no trial. Starter covers 250 conversations a month and 1,000 synced products, with full customisation and 30 days of insights. Pro covers 750 conversations and 10,000 products with advanced insights and 90 days of history, and Scale 2,000 conversations, unlimited products, a year of history and priority support. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Worth knowing before you install. The vendor's own site, cloze.bot/pricing, advertised a different and cheaper ladder on the same day: Free forever with 50 conversations a month, Pro $29 a month and Business $79 a month. On that page both paid tiers say unlimited conversations rather than a monthly allowance. Our link goes to the App Store listing, so the $49/$99/$199 ladder, with its caps of 250, 750 and 2,000 conversations, is what you pay when you install there. The screenshot further down is their own page exactly as we captured it. Developer Optify, Lyon, France; the app launched 24 April 2026, carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge and had no reviews at all at the time of writing. Re-read on 4 September 2026: both ladders still stood exactly as described above, and the listing had gained its first review — a single five-star note left on 14 August 2026 by a French store eight days in. Re-verified 11 October 2026: the App Store ladder (Free 25, Starter $49 for 250, Pro $99 for 750, Scale $199 for 2,000 conversations, $0.10 each beyond, 3-day trials) is unchanged, and so is the different ladder on cloze.bot/pricing (Free 50 conversations, Pro $29 and Business $79 with unlimited conversations). The listing still carries one review, dated 14 August 2026. Read again 16 Nov 2026: the App Store ladder is unchanged (Free 25, Starter $49 for 250, Pro $99 for 750, Scale $199 for 2,000 conversations, $0.10 each beyond, 3 day trial listed on the paid plans), and so is the ladder on cloze.bot/pricing (Free 50 conversations, Pro $29 and Business $79 with unlimited conversations; the page has Start Pro trial and Start Business trial buttons and does not state a trial length).

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 16 November 2026 the session tested Cloze, the Shopify AI chat app (not Cloze CRM), on the Free plan of a Shopify development store: the install, syncing products, one shopper question in the editor preview, the three price lists, the plan screens up to the Shopify approval screen and the uninstall dialog. Nothing was paid, approved or uninstalled. The app overview step 2 showed 0 / 18 products synced with a button Review sources, which opened AI Training, tab Knowledge, with the text No products have been synced from the connected store yet. Sync products now gave the toast products sync queued; after 15 seconds the list was still at 0 and after a reload it read Products (16) with Last synced Nov 16, 01:07 PM UTC. That is 16 products and not 18; the reason was not looked into. Policies, FAQs, pages, orders and collections were all (0). Step 1, Enable in theme, opened the theme editor (app embeds) with Cloze Chat Widget off. We switched it on and in the preview a bar appeared at the bottom with What products do you recommend?. The theme change was not saved, was undone and the editor tab was closed, so the widget is not live in the theme. In the editor preview we asked How much is the 3p Fulfilled Snowboard and is it in stock? and the answer was The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard is priced at 2,629.95 USD and it is currently in stock., with a product card showing $2,629.95. The response took about 5 seconds, by eye and not timed. The Cloze product list says $2629.95 and 20 in stock and Shopify says 20 in stock; the price field in Shopify itself (the variant price) was not checked separately. The settings screens under AI Training, General showed Assistant role: Store guide, Response length: Balanced and Inventory visibility: Show only In Stock / Out of Stock; they were not tried further. Timing, approximate tester observations: from clicking Install at 14:06 to the answer at about 14:08, roughly 2 minutes in 6 steps (Install in the App Store, Install in the dialog, Sync products now, Enable in theme, switch the widget on, type and send the question). No email address, account or password was needed. Uninstall: the app menu offers Manage app, Pin to your navigation and Uninstall; Manage app opens the Shopify app page with View in Shopify App Store, Write review, View activity and Uninstall app; the Uninstall Cloze dialog (reason list, feedback box) was opened and cancelled. The app says a paid plan is changed or cancelled through Shopify; a cancellation of a subscription was not tested because there was no subscription. Not tested: a real payment, the trial, a plan change, the chatbot on the real storefront (the store has a password and the widget was only seen in the unsaved editor preview), policy and shipping questions, order status, human takeover, other languages, discounts, upsell, analytics, a catalogue above 100 products, the behaviour at the limit of 25 conversations, and contact with the developer. One AI conversation was used (24 of 25 left). No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The buttons on cloze.bot only lead to the general App Store, 16 of 18 products synced without a reason, and the vendor site shows other plans and prices than the listing and the app.

friction.export_route: No export or reimport was performed; no file was downloaded or examined. The two categorised kit records were not entered; the objects tested were not kit records.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 16 November 2026 the session tested Cloze, the Shopify AI chat app (not Cloze CRM), on the Free plan of a Shopify development store: the install, syncing products, one shopper question in the editor preview, the three price lists, the plan screens up to the Shopify approval screen and the uninstall dialog. Nothing was paid, approved or uninstalled. The app overview step 2 showed 0 / 18 products synced with a button Review sources, which opened AI Training, tab Knowledge, with the text No products have been synced from the connected store yet. Sync products now gave the toast products sync queued; after 15 seconds the list was still at 0 and after a reload it read Products (16) with Last synced Nov 16, 01:07 PM UTC. That is 16 products and not 18; the reason was not looked into. Policies, FAQs, pages, orders and collections were all (0). Step 1, Enable in theme, opened the theme editor (app embeds) with Cloze Chat Widget off. We switched it on and in the preview a bar appeared at the bottom with What products do you recommend?. The theme change was not saved, was undone and the editor tab was closed, so the widget is not live in the theme. In the editor preview we asked How much is the 3p Fulfilled Snowboard and is it in stock? and the answer was The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard is priced at 2,629.95 USD and it is currently in stock., with a product card showing $2,629.95. The response took about 5 seconds, by eye and not timed. The Cloze product list says $2629.95 and 20 in stock and Shopify says 20 in stock; the price field in Shopify itself (the variant price) was not checked separately. The settings screens under AI Training, General showed Assistant role: Store guide, Response length: Balanced and Inventory visibility: Show only In Stock / Out of Stock; they were not tried further. Timing, approximate tester observations: from clicking Install at 14:06 to the answer at about 14:08, roughly 2 minutes in 6 steps (Install in the App Store, Install in the dialog, Sync products now, Enable in theme, switch the widget on, type and send the question). No email address, account or password was needed. Uninstall: the app menu offers Manage app, Pin to your navigation and Uninstall; Manage app opens the Shopify app page with View in Shopify App Store, Write review, View activity and Uninstall app; the Uninstall Cloze dialog (reason list, feedback box) was opened and cancelled. The app says a paid plan is changed or cancelled through Shopify; a cancellation of a subscription was not tested because there was no subscription. Not tested: a real payment, the trial, a plan change, the chatbot on the real storefront (the store has a password and the widget was only seen in the unsaved editor preview), policy and shipping questions, order status, human takeover, other languages, discounts, upsell, analytics, a catalogue above 100 products, the behaviour at the limit of 25 conversations, and contact with the developer. One AI conversation was used (24 of 25 left). No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The buttons on cloze.bot only lead to the general App Store, 16 of 18 products synced without a reason, and the vendor site shows other plans and prices than the listing and the app.
